narrative.overview: The app is the factory's IT control room: a dark navy frame around a calm, bright working area where every status reads at a glance. The frame carries the identity; the working area stays light, quiet and dense enough to hold a day's records. Colour is spent on state, never on decoration. The system is Thai-first, one family for both scripts, codes in monospace; light and dark are both first-class.
keyCharacteristics: Navy frame, light working area, white cards on a cool grey ground.
Single action colour (signal blue); state colours carry meaning only.
Soft, generous rounding (10px controls, 16px cards) with ambient shadows.
Thai + Latin in one family; codes in monospace.
Three nav forms by width: top bar + drawer (phone), icon rail (tablet / unfolded Fold), full sidebar (desktop).

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue outside the navy frame and signal blue always means a state. Never use a status colour as decoration.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Signal blue marks what can be pressed or what is selected. A screen has one filled blue button per task.

rules.name: The Code Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Every machine identifier is set in IBM Plex Mono; Thai text never is.

rules.name: The Flat Frame Rule
rules.body: The navy frame never casts or receives shadow; depth exists only in the working area.

dos: Do keep the navy frame (#0F2A44) for navigation only and the working area light.
Do use one filled signal-blue button per task; other actions are secondary or ghost.
Do set every SR number, asset tag, serial and IP in IBM Plex Mono.
Do express status with the tinted pill pairs and priority with the solid P1-P4 badges.
Do give every new page the same header, card radius (16px) and table box as existing pages.
Do check both themes; in dark, swap card shadows for 1px borders.
donts: Don't use status colours (green, amber, red, violet, orange) as decoration or category colour without meaning.
Don't add a delete action or a red destructive button for removing records; cancel by status.
Don't introduce new radii, shadows or greys outside the tokens above.
Don't set Thai text in the monospace face.
